   618	op_import(){
   619	  preflight
   620	  local from; from="$(o from)"; [[ -n "$from" ]] || usage "import --from <pending file> required"
   621	  [[ -f "$from" ]] || die "import: pending file not found: $from"
   622	  if has file; then resolve_target write; else
   623	    [[ $IS_WORKTREE -eq 0 ]] || die "import runs in the main checkout (this is a linked worktree)"
   624	    local why; if why="$(ci_blocked)"; then die "refused: ${why} is set"; fi
   625	    TARGET="$LIVE"; TARGET_KIND="live"; [[ -f "$TARGET" ]] || die "ledger not found: $TARGET"
   626	  fi
   627	  local pv; pv="$(PROJECT_ROOT="$PROJECT_ROOT" bash "$VALIDATOR" --type decisions --file "$from" 2>&1)" || die "import: the pending file fails validation:"$'\n'"$pv"
   628	  acquire_lock "$TARGET"
   629	  local old pend n; old="$(read_ledger "$TARGET")"; pend="$(read_ledger "$from")"
   630	  n="$(printf '%s' "$pend" | jq '.decisions | length')"
   631	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || die "import: no rows in $from"
   632	  # Allocate ids in file order, then rewrite every PEND reference inside the imported rows.
   633	  local map="{}" pid i next cur="$old"
   634	  for (( i = 0; i < n; i++ )); do
   635	    pid="$(printf '%s' "$pend" | jq -r --argjson i "$i" '.decisions[$i].id')"
   636	    [[ "$pid" =~ ^PEND-[0-9a-f]{8}$ ]] || die "import: row $i has id $pid, not PEND-<8 hex>"
   637	    next="$(next_dec_id "$cur")"
   638	    map="$(jq -cn --argjson m "$map" --arg p "$pid" --arg d "$next" '$m + {($p): $d}')"
   639	    cur="$(printf '%s' "$cur" | jq -c --arg d "$next" '.decisions += [{id: $d}]')"
   640	  done
   641	  begin_tmp
   642	  local rows touched r; rows="$(printf '%s' "$pend" | jq -c --argjson m "$map" '
   643	      def rw: reduce ($m | to_entries[]) as $e (.; gsub($e.key; $e.value));
   644	      .decisions[] | walk(if type == "string" then rw else . end)')"
   645	  touched="$(jq -cn --argjson m "$map" '[$m[]]')"
   646	  while IFS= read -r r; do [[ -z "$r" ]] || append_row "$r"; done <<< "$rows"
   647	  verify_and_swap "$old" "$n" "$touched"
   648	  local p tmp2
   649	  while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
   650	    [[ -f "$p" ]] || { warn "import: --rewrite target not found: $p"; continue; }
   651	    tmp2="$(mktemp "${p}.XXXXXX")"
   652	    printf '%s' "$map" | jq -r 'to_entries[] | "\(.key)\t\(.value)"' | awk -F'\t' 'NR == FNR { m[$1] = $2; next } { for (k in m) gsub(k, m[k]); print }' - "$p" > "$tmp2"
   653	    chmod 0644 "$tmp2"; mv -f "$tmp2" "$p"
   654	  done < <(om rewrite)
   655	  rm -f -- "$from"
   656	  printf '%s' "$map" | jq -r 'to_entries[] | "\(.key) \(.value)"'
   657	  log "dec-write: imported ${n} row(s) from ${from}; pending file removed. A bead whose external_ref holds a PEND id: br update <bead> --external-ref <DEC id> (beads stay with the lead)"
   658	}

   660	op_list(){
   661	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "list: jq is required"
   662	  command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "list: Mike Farah yq v4 is required"
   663	  resolve_target read
   664	  local fmt; fmt="$(o format)"; fmt="${fmt:-tsv}"
   665	  [[ "$fmt" =~ ^(tsv|md|json)$ ]] || usage "--format must be tsv, md or json"
   666	  local j
   667	  if [[ ! -f "$TARGET" ]]; then j='{"schema_version":1,"decisions":[]}'; else
   668	    j="$(yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$TARGET" 2>/dev/null)" || die "list: unparsable ledger ${TARGET}"
   669	    printf '%s' "$j" | jq -e '.schema_version == 1' >/dev/null 2>&1 || warn "list: unknown schema_version in ${TARGET}"
   670	    printf '%s' "$j" | jq -e '(.decisions // []) | type == "array"' >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "list: no decisions sequence in ${TARGET}"
   671	  fi
   672	  local voice; voice="$(o voice)"; [[ -n "$voice" ]] || voice="$(o decided-by)"
   673	  local ids; ids="$(om id | tr '\0' ',')"
   674	  printf '%s' "$j" | jq -r --arg fmt "$fmt" --arg st "$(o status)" --arg vo "$voice" --arg nv "$(o not-decided-by)" \
   675	    --arg cy "$(o cycle)" --arg since "$(o since)" --arg sp "$(o source-prefix)" --arg se "$(o source-epic)" --arg ids "$ids" '
   676	    def csv: if . == "" then [] else split(",") | map(select(length > 0)) end;
   677	    def cl: tostring | gsub("[[:cntrl:]]"; " ");
   678	    def mc: cl | gsub("\\|"; "\\|");
   679	    ($st | csv) as $S | ($vo | csv) as $V | ($nv | csv) as $NV | ($ids | csv) as $I
   680	    | [ (.decisions // [])[]
   681	        | (.decided_by // .proposed_by // "") as $voice | (.status // "") as $status | (.id // "") as $id
   682	        | select(($S | length) == 0 or ($S | index($status)))
   683	        | select(($V | length) == 0 or ($V | index($voice)))
   684	        | select(($NV | length) == 0 or (($NV | index($voice)) | not))
   685	        | select($cy == "" or .cycle == $cy)
   686	        | select($since == "" or ((.created_at // "") >= $since))
   687	        | select($sp == "" or ((.source // "") | startswith($sp)))
   688	        | select($se == "" or ((.source // "") | startswith("map:" + $se + "/")))
   689	        | select(($I | length) == 0 or ($I | index($id)))
   690	        | . + {voice: $voice} ] as $rows
   691	    | if $fmt == "json" then ($rows | tojson)
   692	      elif $fmt == "tsv" then ($rows[] | [.id, .status, .voice, (.summary // ""), (.source // "")] | map(cl) | join("\t"))
   693	      else
   694	        if ($rows | length) == 0 then "_None: every decision in this run was the operator'"'"'s._"
   695	        else ("| Decision | Voice | Status | Why | Source |", "|---|---|---|---|---|",
   696	              ($rows[] | "| \((.summary // "") | mc) (\(.id)) | \(.voice | mc) | \(.status | mc) | \((.rationale // "") | mc) | \((.source // "") | mc) |"),
   697	              "Confirm with /decisions confirm.")
   698	        end
   699	      end'
   700	}

@@ -0,0 +1,573 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# dec-write-lib.bats: the decision-ledger writer (.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh).
+#
+# Hermetic: every test copies the writer, its validator and compat-lib into a fresh temp project
+# (its own git repo and .run), so the host's run state, the live ledger and the operator's session
+# never leak in. The live grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml of this repository is never written.
+# Seams: the CLI (subcommands, exit codes) and the ledger file after each operation.
+# =============================================================================
+
+# An empty ledger carrying the tracked file's header only: fixtures never inherit live rows
+# (the live ledger is seeded in the main checkout).
+empty_ledger(){ { sed '/^schema_version:/,$d' "$1"; printf 'schema_version: 1\ndecisions: []\n'; } > "$2"; }
+
+setup() {
+  BATS_TEST_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
+  REPO="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "jq not installed"
+  command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "yq not installed"
+  [[ "$(yq --version 2>&1)" == *mikefarah*"version v4."* ]] || skip "Mike Farah yq v4 not installed"
+  unset CLAUDE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID LOA_UNATTENDED LOA_FLATLINE_MODE CI GITHUB_ACTIONS \
+        LOA_HOOK_CONTEXT LOA_DEC_NO_FLOCK LOA_DEC_LOCK_WAIT
+  T="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/proj"
+  mkdir -p "$T/.claude/scripts/lib" "$T/grimoires/loa"
+  cp "$REPO/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh" "$T/.claude/scripts/lib/"
+  cp "$REPO/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh" "$REPO/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh" "$T/.claude/scripts/"
+  [[ -f "$REPO/.claude/scripts/pii-filter.sh" ]] && cp "$REPO/.claude/scripts/pii-filter.sh" "$T/.claude/scripts/"
+  empty_ledger "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml" "$T/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml"
+  git -C "$T" init -q
+  D="$T/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh"
+  L="$T/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml"
+  F="$T/fixture.yaml"
+  cp "$L" "$F"
+  ALT='{"option":"keep sequential","rejected_because":"one question per turn is slow"}'
+}
+
+# Same transformation as the writer's san1() (kf-write-lib.sh's), used to state expected values.
+DEC_ULB_RE="$(printf '\302[\200-\237]|\342\200[\250\251]')"
+san1(){ printf '%s' "${1-}" | LC_ALL=C tr -d '\000-\010\013\014\016-\037\177' | LC_ALL=C tr '\t\n\r' '   ' | LC_ALL=C sed -E "s/${DEC_ULB_RE}/ /g"' ; s/  +/ /g; s/^ //; s/ $//'; }
+
+# new_open FILE [extra args]  -> an open row
+new_open(){ local f="$1"; shift; bash "$D" new --file "$f" --summary "an open question" --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by plan-and-analyze --source "prd.md#fr-1" --quiet "$@"; }
+# new_prop FILE [extra args]  -> a proposed row
+new_prop(){ local f="$1"; shift; bash "$D" new --file "$f" --summary "rounds is the thorough default" --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by plan-and-analyze --source "prd.md#e (D1)" --status proposed --decision "pacing rounds" --rationale "brief recommendation" --alternative-json "$ALT" --cycle cycle-128 --quiet "$@"; }
+field(){ yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$1" | jq -r --arg id "$2" ".decisions[] | select(.id == \$id) | $3"; }
+ids(){ yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$1" | jq -r '[.decisions[].id] | join(",")'; }
+confirm_op(){ bash "$D" confirm --recorded-by decisions-command --evidence "cli:2026-10-13T12:00:00Z" --quiet "$@"; }
+lockpath(){ # target -> the writer's lock path
+  local abs; abs="$(cd "$(dirname "$1")" && pwd -P)/$(basename "$1")"
+  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
+  ( source "$REPO/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"; printf '%s/.run/.dec-write-%s.lock' "$(cd "$T" && pwd -P)" "$(printf '%s' "$abs" | sha256_portable | cut -c1-12)" )
+}
+# A PATH holding every command of the current PATH except $1 (the tool reads as absent).
+path_without(){
+  local tool="$1" d="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/pw-$1" p f b
+  mkdir -p "$d"
+  local IFS=:
+  for p in $PATH; do
+    [[ -d "$p" ]] || continue
+    for f in "$p"/*; do b="${f##*/}"; [[ "$b" == "$tool" || -e "$d/$b" ]] && continue; ln -s "$f" "$d/$b" 2>/dev/null || true; done
+  done
+  printf '%s' "$d"
+}
+
+# ---- ids, growth, verify-before-swap ------------------------------------------------
+
+@test "dec-write new: ids allocate max+1 and print DEC-%04d" {
+  run new_open "$F"; [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ "$output" = "DEC-0001" ]
+  run new_prop "$F"; [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ "$output" = "DEC-0002" ]
+  # a gap: max+1 from the highest id, never a reused or lower one
+  yq -i '.decisions[1].id = "DEC-0007" | .decisions[1].supersedes = null' "$F"
+  run new_open "$F"; [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ "$output" = "DEC-0008" ]
+  [ "$(ids "$F")" = "DEC-0001,DEC-0007,DEC-0008" ]
+}
+
+@test "dec-write: the ledger never shrinks and never drops an id across every operation" {
+  new_open "$F" >/dev/null; new_prop "$F" >/dev/null; new_open "$F" >/dev/null
+  local before; before="$(ids "$F")"
+  bash "$D" decide --file "$F" --id DEC-0001 --decision d --rationale r --alternative-json "$ALT" --evidence "interview turn 3" --recorded-by x --quiet
+  confirm_op --file "$F" --id DEC-0002
+  bash "$D" reject --file "$F" --id DEC-0003 --rationale "out of scope" --follow-up bd-abcd --recorded-by x --quiet
+  run bash "$D" supersede --file "$F" --id DEC-0002 --summary "a newer take" --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by x --source s2 --decision d2 --rationale r2 --alternative-json "$ALT" --quiet
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ "$(ids "$F")" = "${before},DEC-0004" ]
+  [ "$(yq '.decisions | length' "$F")" -eq 4 ]
+}
+
+@test "dec-write: a failed write leaves the previous file byte-identical (validation refuses the candidate)" {
+  new_open "$F" >/dev/null
+  # plant a row the validator refuses (a URL in free text), as a hand edit would
+  yq -i '.decisions[0].summary = "see https://example.com"' "$F"
+  cp "$F" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/before.yaml"
+  run new_open "$F"
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"ledger untouched"* ]]
+  cmp "$F" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/before.yaml"
+  # no temp file is left beside the target
+  [ -z "$(find "$T" -maxdepth 1 -name 'fixture.yaml.*')" ]
+}
+
+@test "dec-write: an unknown schema_version is refused before any write" {
+  yq -i '.schema_version = 2' "$F"; cp "$F" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/before.yaml"
+  run new_open "$F"
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"unknown schema_version"* ]]
+  cmp "$F" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/before.yaml"
+}
+
+@test "dec-write: the header comment survives a write (yq keeps the head comment)" {
+  new_prop "$F" >/dev/null
+  grep -q '^# grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml: the decision ledger' "$F"
+  grep -q '^schema_version: 1' "$F"
+}
+
+@test "dec-write: ids come from the target file only; a populated live ledger does not shift a fresh --file fixture" {
+  # a throwaway "live" ledger with rows, at the project's live path
+  local i; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do bash "$D" new --summary "live row $i" --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by x --source s --quiet >/dev/null; done
+  [ "$(yq '.decisions | length' "$L")" -eq 5 ]
+  # and a populated ledger at another path
+  cp "$L" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/other.yaml"
+  empty_ledger "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/fresh.yaml"
+  run bash "$D" new --file "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/fresh.yaml" --summary s --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by x --source s --quiet
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ "$output" = "DEC-0001" ]
+  run bash "$D" list --file "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/fresh.yaml" --format json
+  [ "$(printf '%s' "$output" | jq 'length')" -eq 1 ]
+  # the live ledger continues from its own max
+  run bash "$D" new --summary "live row 6" --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by x --source s --quiet
+  [ "$output" = "DEC-0006" ]
+  [ "$(yq '.decisions | length' "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/other.yaml")" -eq 5 ]
+}
+
+# ---- required fields, transitions, operator-only ops ----------------------------------
+
+@test "dec-write: decide and confirm without --evidence, reject without --rationale or --follow-up exit non-zero" {
+  new_open "$F" >/dev/null; new_prop "$F" >/dev/null
+  run bash "$D" decide --file "$F" --id DEC-0001 --decision d --rationale r --alternative-json "$ALT" --recorded-by x
+  [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; [[ "$output" == *"--evidence is required"* ]]
+  run bash "$D" confirm --file "$F" --id DEC-0002 --recorded-by decisions-command
+  [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; [[ "$output" == *"--evidence is required"* ]]
+  run bash "$D" reject --file "$F" --id DEC-0002 --rationale "no" --recorded-by x
+  [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; [[ "$output" == *"--follow-up is required"* ]]
+  run bash "$D" reject --file "$F" --id DEC-0002 --follow-up bd-x --recorded-by x
+  [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; [[ "$output" == *"--rationale is required"* ]]
+  [ "$(field "$F" DEC-0001 .status)" = "open" ]; [ "$(field "$F" DEC-0002 .status)" = "proposed" ]
+}
+
+@test "dec-write: a proposed row needs a decision, a rationale and an alternative" {
+  run bash "$D" new --file "$F" --summary s --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by x --source src --status proposed --decision d
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]; [[ "$output" == *"needs --decision, --rationale and at least one --alternative-json"* ]]
+  run bash "$D" new --file "$F" --summary s --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by x --source src --status decided
+  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+  [ "$(yq '.decisions | length' "$F")" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "dec-write: every write lands open or proposed and decided_by stays null" {
+  new_open "$F" >/dev/null; new_prop "$F" >/dev/null
+  [ "$(field "$F" DEC-0001 '.status + "|" + (.decided_by|tostring) + "|" + .proposed_by')" = "open|null|agent" ]
+  [ "$(field "$F" DEC-0002 '.status + "|" + (.decided_by|tostring) + "|" + .proposed_by')" = "proposed|null|agent" ]
+  [ "$(field "$F" DEC-0002 '.transitions[0] | "\(.from)>\(.to) \(.by)"')" = "null>proposed agent:plan-and-analyze" ]
+}
+
+@test "dec-write decide: open -> proposed appends one transition and sets the decide fields once" {

That signal is a permanent artifact property, not a live signal, yet it drives derive_attribution for confirm/reject/supersede: an operator confirm with --answer-ref cli:... records decided_by agent; an operator reject of a decided row dies; an operator supersede lands as an agent proposal.

4. validate-artifact.sh: --base-file-less path compares against merge-base; "more than one transition appended in one write" fires on a branch with several writes to one row, so a CI run against merge-base fails legitimate histories.

7. user-invoked-harness.bats runs a live, paid `claude -p` call by default in the unit suite whenever the CLI is on PATH.
8. .loa.config.yaml.example sets `pacing: rounds` explicitly, which defeats the documented "minimal → batch" default.
9. discovering-requirements SKILL.md cfg() quoting: `yq eval "$1 // \"$2\""` returns the literal string for booleans; fine, but `.interview.pacing // ""` yields empty string correctly only with yq v4.
10. grimoire-index.bats references loa-learnings-index.sh decisions indexing and path-lib.sh get_decisions_path, which this PR does not add.

set -u; cd /tmp/prtree; unset CI GITHUB_ACTIONS LOA_HOOK_CONTEXT LOA_UNATTENDED LOA_FLATLINE_MODE CLAUDE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID; rm -rf .run; D=.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh; F=/tmp/probe-fixture.yaml; printf 'schema_version: 1\ndecisions: []\n' > $F; ALT='{"option":"a","rejected_because":"b"}'
printf '# PRD\n\n**Date:** 2026-10-13\n**Status:** Draft (autonomous run)\n' > grimoires/loa/prd.md
echo "--- context:"; bash $D context --why
bash $D new --file $F --summary "p1" --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by t --source s --status proposed --decision d --rationale r --alternative-json "$ALT" --quiet
bash $D new --file $F --summary "p2" --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by t --source s --status proposed --decision d --rationale r --alternative-json "$ALT" --quiet
echo "--- operator confirm with cli ref (PRD autonomous):"; bash $D confirm --file $F --id DEC-0001 --recorded-by decisions-command --evidence "cli:2026-10-13T12:00:00Z" --answer-ref "cli:2026-10-13T12:00:00Z"; echo "rc=$?"
yq -o=json -I0 '.decisions[0] | {status, decided_by, decided_by_ref, last: .transitions[-1].by}' $F
echo "--- operator reject of decided row (PRD autonomous):"; bash $D reject --file $F --id DEC-0001 --rationale no --follow-up bd-x --recorded-by decisions-command; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- operator supersede of decided row (PRD autonomous):"; bash $D supersede --file $F --id DEC-0001 --summary s2 --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by decisions-command --source s --decision d --rationale r --alternative-json "$ALT" --answer-ref "cli:2026-10-13T12:00:00Z"; echo "rc=$?"
yq -o=json -I0 '.decisions[0] | {status, supersede_proposed_by}' $F; yq -o=json -I0 '.decisions[2] | {id,status,proposed_by,decided_by_ref}' $F 2>/dev/null
echo "--- remove PRD, operator reject decided:"; rm grimoires/loa/prd.md; bash $D reject --file $F --id DEC-0001 --rationale no --follow-up bd-x --recorded-by decisions-command; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- CI bypass via --file live path:"; cp grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml /tmp/ledger-before.yaml; CI=1 bash $D new --file grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml --summary ci --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by t --source s --quiet; echo "rc=$?"; yq '.decisions | length' grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml; cp /tmp/ledger-before.yaml grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml
echo "--- confirm on a --file pending path:"; mkdir -p grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-9; printf 'schema_version: 1\ndecisions: []\n' > grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-9/decisions-pending.yaml; bash $D new --file grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-9/decisions-pending.yaml --summary x --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by t --source s --status proposed --decision d --rationale r --alternative-json "$ALT" --quiet; echo "rc=$?"; grep -c 'id:' grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-9/decisions-pending.yaml; rm -rf grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-9
echo "--- import --rewrite outside project:"; echo "PEND-deadbeef here" > /tmp/outside.txt; ln -sf /tmp/outside.txt /tmp/link.txt; mkdir -p grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-7; bash $D new --file $F --summary y --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by t --source s --quiet >/dev/null; printf 'schema_version: 1\ndecisions: []\n' > /tmp/pend.yaml; bash $D new --pending --sprint 7 --summary "pend row" --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by t --source s --quiet; P=grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-7/decisions-pending.yaml; pid=$(yq '.decisions[0].id' $P); echo "$pid here" > /tmp/outside.txt; bash $D import --from $P --rewrite /tmp/link.txt --quiet; echo "rc=$?"; ls -l /tmp/link.txt | awk '{print $1,$9,$10,$11}'; cat /tmp/outside.txt; cp /tmp/ledger-before.yaml grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml; rm -rf grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-7 .run

input.command:
cd /workspace && cat > grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md <<'EOF'
# Sprint 1 Review Feedback

**Reviewer:** Senior Tech Lead Reviewer Agent
**Date:** 2026-10-22
**Sprint Reference:** grimoires/loa/sprint.md
**Implementation Report:** grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/reviewer.md (the PR description, `pr/PR.md`)

---

## Overall Assessment

The PR (sprint-252 decision surfaces, part 1) adds the decision-ledger writer `dec-write-lib.sh`, a `--type decisions` validator, the operator-only `/decisions` command and allowlist, the default-off SessionStart surface, the `rounds` interview pacing with its transcript checker, and the grimoire-index `decisions` family. The code is careful in many places (yq values only through `env()`, rows built by `jq --arg`, verify-before-rename, hostile-string corpus, L6 fencing of the surface), and the PR's own bats suites pass when run here: dec-write-lib 44/44, loa-decisions-surface 8/8, check-round-independence 13/13, user-invoked-commands 12/12, user-invoked-harness 4/4 offline (live test skipped), grimoire-index decisions 5/5, validate-artifact 51/51. The agents-md-gen count/checksum tests could not be verified (this workspace carries a different command set); `grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml` itself is not in the PR and is assumed to pre-exist tracked, as the tests assume.

The core invariant the PR sells, however, does not hold. The live-run guard on `confirm` is a `cmd | grep -q` pipeline under `set -o pipefail`: with two or more live signals (the normal autonomous shape, a fresh `.run/unattended.json` plus a RUNNING run state) the producer dies of SIGPIPE, the pipeline returns 141, and confirm proceeds. Reproduced 5 of 5 times. A second attribution defect makes the PRD `**Status:**` line, a permanent planning artifact, drive operator-facing operations: an operator confirm records `decided_by: agent`, an operator reject of a decided row is refused, an operator supersede lands as an agent proposal. Further: `--file <live path>` bypasses the CI/hook/worktree refusals; rejecting a proposed replacement leaves a stale `supersede_proposed_by` that blocks every later agent supersede and makes the operator's reject of the original abort; `import` commits the live ledger before rewrites and before removing the pending file, so a partial failure duplicates rows on retry and a concurrent worker's row is dropped; and the validator's merge-base path false-fails any branch where one row moved open → proposed → decided.

Adversarial dissent (two independent voices, gpt-5.5-pro via codex-headless and claude-headless) ran against `pr/head.diff`; its four BLOCKING findings were each verified in a scratch tree before being counted below; its advisory findings are triaged under Cross-Model Observations. No payload was rejected.

**Verdict:** CHANGES REQUIRED

---

## Changes Required

### 1. Security / Integrity — the operator-only guard on `confirm` fails under the normal autonomous-run shape (dissent DISS-C-001, verified)

- **CRITICAL** (confidence: high) `head/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh:184` — `live_run_signal(){ ctx_signals | grep -q '^live ' ; }` runs under `set -euo pipefail`; `grep -q` exits on the first match, `ctx_signals` then writes its next line into a closed pipe, dies with SIGPIPE (141), and the pipeline is false, so `if live_run_signal; then die …` at `head/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh:509` never fires when two or more live signals exist.
**File:** `head/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh:184`, used at `head/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh:509`
**Issue:** Reproduced in a scratch copy: `context --set-unattended` (fresh marker) plus `.run/sprint-plan-state.json` `{"state":"RUNNING"}` → `context --why` lists two `live` signals → `confirm --id DEC-000N --recorded-by decisions-command --evidence cli:…` succeeded 5/5 times and every row became `decided`. The isolated pipeline (`f | grep -q` with a `jq` fork between echoes) returned 141 on 3/3 runs. `autonomous-agent/SKILL.md:66` now tells every unattended run to write the marker while the run state is RUNNING, which is exactly the two-signal shape.
**Why This Matters:** `decisions.md:59` and the file header (`:17`) promise that confirm refuses during a live unattended run; this is the invariant that keeps agent-proposed rows `proposed` until a human confirms. It silently does not hold.
**Required Fix:** Capture, then test: `live_run_signal(){ local s; s="$(ctx_signals)" || true; grep -q '^live ' <<< "$s"; }` (or test `is_unattended`-style on the captured string). Add a bats case with two live signals (marker + RUNNING) asserting confirm exits 1.
**Reference:** CWE-754 (improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions); bash pipefail + SIGPIPE semantics.

### 2. Functionality / Attribution — the PRD Status line is treated as a live unattended signal for operator operations (verified)

- **HIGH** (confidence: high) `head/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh:183` — `is_unattended()` is true on any `ctx_signals` line, including `prd prd-status` (`:177-180`), so with `grimoires/loa/prd.md` carrying `**Status:** Draft (autonomous run)` the operator's own calls are demoted: `confirm --answer-ref cli:…` has its ref dropped at `:314` and records `decided_by: agent` (`:538`); `reject` of a decided row dies at `:575`; `supersede` by the operator takes the agent path at `:600-611`.
**File:** `head/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh:183` (also `:313-317`, `:575`, `:600-611`)
**Issue:** Reproduced: with that PRD line, `confirm --recorded-by decisions-command --evidence cli:… --answer-ref cli:…` → WARN "--answer-ref ignored" and the row reads `decided_by: agent, decided_by_ref: null` while its last transition says `by: operator:decisions-command`; `reject --id DEC-0001 --recorded-by decisions-command` → "the context is unattended; the operator rejects it interactively" (exit 1); operator `supersede` left DEC-0001 `decided` with `supersede_proposed_by` and the new row `proposed_by: agent`. The PRD Status line persists after an autonomous planning run, so these operations stay broken for the whole cycle. The PR's own test at `head/tests/unit/dec-write-lib.bats:355-367` shows the intent (the PRD line must not block confirm) but only asserts `.status`, not `decided_by`.
**Why This Matters:** `decided_by` is the field the whole feature exists to make trustworthy ("which decisions did a human take?"). Here a human confirmation is recorded as the agent's, and the operator cannot reject or supersede.
**Required Fix:** Split the scopes: the PRD line is a planning-time default for `new`/`decide` only (status → proposed, refs ignored); `confirm`, `reject`, `supersede` and `context`'s verdict follow live signals only (`live_run_signal`, once fixed per §1). Extend the bats test to assert `decided_by == operator` with the PRD line present.

### 3. Security — `--file <live ledger>` bypasses the CI/hook refusal and the worktree redirect (verified)

- **HIGH** (confidence: high) `head/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh:251` — every `--file` target is `TARGET_KIND="fixture"` and returns before the `ci_blocked` check at `:261`, so `CI=1 dec-write-lib.sh new --file grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml …` writes the live ledger (reproduced: exit 0, row appended), a hook with `LOA_HOOK_CONTEXT=1` can do the same, a linked worktree can write the main ledger by path instead of its pending file, and `confirm`/`supersede` on a `--file …/decisions-pending.yaml` escape their pending-file refusals at `:512` and `:593`.
